bugs.title: Completed trucks lose their star badges while another owner's level is in progress
bugs.evidence: Check p4-isolation-resume, failed twice. After completeTrucks(['wing','jasmine']) and a reload with Fong mid-Arrange, the store restores correctly: activeOwner fong, beat arrange, placements {roof:kumquat,counter:orchid}, notebook budget HK$1000, 3 conversation lines, completed=[wing,jasmine]. Both trucks are visibly decorated. But on Back to harbour, getByTestId('truck-stars-wing') is not found (screenshot p4-isolation-resume-failure.png). Root cause in frontend/src/scene/Truck.jsx Stars(): the badge shows only when s.level.beat is 'done' or 'idle', and s.level is the ACTIVE owner's level (fong=arrange), so stars for other completed trucks are hidden. Frontend-only bug: the backend is healthy (25/25 pytest pass), and the stars do show once all three trucks are complete (parade screenshot). Suggested fix: gate on s.completed[ownerId] alone, or on s.levels[ownerId].beat.

action_items.detail: Ribbon latency: POST /api/ribbon answers in about 2.1 s (llm) and 0 ms (forced fallback) via curl. In the UI, the time from placing the stand to level.ribbon being set was 7.1 s (live) and 3.7 s (forced fallback), so the client seems to add about 3.5 s of delay. Headless rendering is slow, but the about 4 s target may be missed. Please review.

Trust raising Crowd versus a no-Trust run was not compared numerically in the UI. Trust rising (0 to 2 after a personal question) is verified in the browser, and the backend test test_personal_trust passes.
The start-name-tutorial check hung on a non-forced click of the animated kit bubble. It was rewritten with force clicks and step timeouts, and now passes. This was a test issue, not an app bug.
8 criteria, all exercised. Audio and live intel are not reported, per spec_deviations.
